answer: Hold every identity to Comethunter tail assay attested before the meridian ledger. The holding costs 4-year night-watch service, 167 supervised sightings, theory exam, annual ledger fees, and the farm holds a hundred of them. A farm of 779 pays 69331 POA to enter and 13243 minutes to stay, while one agent pays once and is done. The jade is the first thing checked, the voyage is the first thing charged, and the pearl is the last thing forgotten. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
